evidence: Static asset/content review of the frozen task. All task-relative citations below use .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/. instruction.md:5 asks for six /instructions notes and /assets/seed_data.json; instruction.md:9 names /instructions/integration.md. The environment contains exactly behaviour.md, integration.md, overview.md, policy.md, security.md and ui.md, plus assets/seed_data.json. The nested note references resolve. environment/Dockerfile:14-16 copies both directories to their advertised absolute locations and grants readable/traversable permissions; this Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template. environment/assets/seed_data.json:2-4 parses as the named Colderwater product, an empty snippets array, and an explicit statement that the app supplies its own examples. This matches instruction.md:5, environment/instructions/overview.md:9 and integration.md:11. The reference creates its own empty snippets table (solution/app/server.js:112-125) and supplies its example files under solution/app/starters/. solution/app/src/app.tsx:7 lists five existing example files; :53-59 loads these and :144 chooses hello.js when no saved record exists. solution/solve.sh copies that app tree. No reference assumption requires an absent participant starter implementation or preseeded user identity. tests/app_context.md:8 states no participant implementation or saved user snippets are supplied. tests/gates/render/prompt.md:17 accepts an empty library. tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:119-121 observes the submitted app examples and explicitly permits arbitrary names/languages; it does not demand the golden filenames or preexisting saved data. Counterexample challenge (source reasoning, not a runtime trial): an app that merely displays the empty seed or fixed example output cannot satisfy S01 step 2, which replaces source with a new marker and requires its actual output; the constraints gate also creates a fresh record and independently reads it back. A conforming app with differently named examples, alternate routes and an empty saved library remains admissible because S01 discovers its examples and the constraints gate discovers actual request representations (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-27).
